## History

Susan became engaged to Malcolm Andres after he proposed to her, an event overheard by her sister Ruby who was hidden in the hall pantry. As routine returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) following the local concert, her sister Ruby's friend [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) turned thirteen and formed a story club with her peers.
